title: 第21章 凭本事抢的凭什么还你第22章 这小孩这么直接吗
slug: 太古神墟第1974章药园小酌
content_zh:
一个毫无灵气波动的人族小孩，仅凭肉身的力量，一个照面斩杀了元婴境的魔族狠人。
所有的人兽都呆若木鸡。
血雾在空中飘散，空气中弥漫着令人窒息的血腥。
周围一瞬间安静下来，远处的厮杀也停下了，一切仿佛都静止了。
落尘好像根本没有注意到周围的变化，走到锤子前，双手拎起大锤，举过头顶。
小小的身材，轻松举起直径比他身高还大的大锤，场面让人震惊。
“这锤子好，重量也够，以后砸人有东西了。”
落尘对锤子很满意，把弄锤子转来转去欣赏，一万八千斤重量，他转动起来丝毫不费力气。
阴森的魔族男子见机会来了，嘴里念念有词，手中的剑一挥，一连串黑色的火苗从剑尖涌出，在空中分散开来，发出“啾啾”
的声音，像一条条火蛇，从四面八方扑向落尘。
落尘真正专心致志欣赏锤子，躲闪不及，身上被好几朵黑色的火苗击中。
衣服烧了好多洞。
“完了，焚脏魔火！
还是年龄太小了，毫无对敌经验。
可惜了，唉，我命当绝啊。”
大阵里的牛魔王叹了一口气。
“这，这，这是焚脏魔火，呜呜……”
搬山熊呜咽着闭上眼睛。
焚脏魔火，霸道无比。
只要粘在身上，必然进入身体焚烧五脏六腑。

好几头妖兽都中了这一招，临死前的挣扎惨不忍睹。
“哈哈，哈哈，中了我的焚脏魔火，任你有三头六臂也必死无疑。
哈哈哈。”
阴森男子得意狂笑。
他得意的有点早，落尘的庚金肤，那可是混沌九重天炼体诀炼成的，还是极境。
怎么会怕这小小的魔火。
衣服被烧了好几个洞，落尘愣了一下，很心疼，能穿的衣服就剩这一套了。
“尼玛的，把我衣服烧了好几个洞，找死！”
落尘突然暴怒，手中的大锤奔着阴森男子扔了出去。
巨大的呼啸声在众人耳边轰鸣，阴森男子想躲，来不及了，大锤直接砸在身上，地面出现一个深坑。
笑声似乎还未停止，直接变成肉泥了，坟坑都不用挖了。
“对不起啊，你真不抗打，没想到把你打成泥了，你倒是躲啊。
应该给你留个全尸的……”
落尘来到在大坑边念念叨叨，要多气人有多气人。
“你的剑也不结实啊，怎么碎成这样。
content_en:
A human child with no spiritual energy fluctuations, relying only on the strength of his body, killed a ruthless demon in the Nascent Soul realm.
All the humans and beasts were stunned.
Blood mist floated in the air, and the air was filled with suffocating blood.
The surrounding area became quiet for a moment, and the fighting in the distance stopped. Everything seemed to be still.
Luochen didn't seem to notice the changes around him at all. He walked to the hammer, picked up the sledgehammer with both hands, and raised it above his head.
With his small stature, he could easily lift a sledgehammer with a diameter larger than his height. The scene was shocking.
"This hammer is good and heavy enough. I'll have something to hit people with in the future."
Luochen was very satisfied with the hammer. He turned the hammer around and admired it. It weighed 18,000 kilograms and he could turn it without any effort at all.
Seeing the opportunity, the gloomy demon man muttered something in his mouth, waved the sword in his hand, and a series of black flames surged out from the tip of the sword and spread out in the air, making a "chirp" sound.
The sound was like fiery snakes, rushing towards Luochen from all directions.
Luochen was really concentrating on admiring the hammer, but he couldn't dodge and was hit by several black flames.
There were a lot of holes burned into the clothes.
"It's over, Burning Evil Fire!
He is still too young and has no experience against the enemy.
What a pity, alas, my fate is doomed. "
The Bull Demon King in the formation sighed.
"This, this, this is the Zang-burning demonic fire, wuwu..."
Mountain Bear whimpered and closed his eyes.
The demonic fire that burns the internal organs is extremely domineering.
As long as it sticks to the body, it will definitely enter the body and burn the internal organs.
Several monster beasts were hit by this move, and their struggles before death were horrific.
"Haha, haha, if you are hit by my Zang-burning demonic fire, you will definitely die even if you have three heads and six arms.
Hahaha. "
The sinister man laughed triumphantly.
He was a little proud of himself a little early. The dusty Geng Gold Skin was made from the Chaos Nine Heavens Body Refining Technique, and it was still at the extreme level.
How could you be afraid of this little devil fire?
Several holes were burned into his clothes. Luochen was stunned for a moment and felt very distressed. This was the only set of clothes he could wear.
"Damn it, you burned several holes in my clothes. I'm looking for death!"
Luochen suddenly became furious and threw the sledgehammer in his hand towards the sinister man.
A huge whistling sound roared in everyone's ears. The sinister man wanted to hide, but it was too late. The sledgehammer hit him directly, and a deep pit appeared on the ground.
It seems that the laughter has not stopped yet, it has turned into meat and meat, and there is no need to dig a grave.
"I'm sorry, you really can't resist the beating. I didn't expect it to turn you into mud, so you tried to hide.
You should be left with a complete corpse..."
Luochen came to the big pit and muttered, "I want to make people angry as much as possible."
"Your sword isn't strong either, why is it broken like this?
